narrative_purpose: The figure separates recovery of bodies from recovery of information: suitable habitat can remain physically intact after the learned route into it has vanished from living memory.
subject: A seamless before-and-after ocean panorama around the same sheltered coastal bay. On the left, an experienced baleen-whale mother leads a calf and several companions through a narrow underwater passage into the bay, their repeated route visible only as subtle teal particles stirred in their wake. On the right years later, a small recovering group of younger whales travels past the same intact entrance in open water; the old path fades and stops before reaching them, while the bay remains empty. No dead animals, blood, text, arrows, panels or UI.
scene: A temperate rocky bay and underwater shelf shown continuously across time, ecologically intact on both sides; the only missing element in the later moment is the knowledgeable leader and the group's use of the route.
camera: High oblique cutaway wide view showing open sea, the narrow passage and sheltered bay, with the earlier procession at left and later offshore group at right.
light: Soft cyan daylight over the unchanged coast; teal wake particles clearly continue into the bay in the earlier moment but dissolve in empty water before the later pod; muted amber light rests inside the unused cove.
palette: Deep indigo and slate water, stone coast, cyan whale edges, teal memory trail and a restrained amber empty-bay accent.
style: Painterly conservation-science plate, elegiac and spatially legible without becoming a literal ghost story.
detail_level: Crisp whales, passage and route discontinuity; coast and deep water simplified into quiet layered shapes with room for interface annotations.
composition: The unchanged bay anchors the center; an earlier group enters it from one side while a later group passes offshore on the other, making absence visible without a written before-and-after label.
consistency_notes: Use anatomically correct Earth baleen whales and keep the habitat physically suitable in both temporal halves. Do not imply that the later animals genetically lost migration; the missing link is social demonstration.
negative_prompt: no text, no labels, no arrows, no split-screen border, no ghost, no carcass, no hunting violence, no photographic or CGI look, no cartoon style
